message: In the concealed under-deck support frame (C2), the bolted cross-frame connection for the added Tuned Mass Damper (TMD) mass has needed quantified peak load and fatigue margin, Manager. To check it I used hand calculation with static plus dynamic summation reusing the repeated check calculation (E10) with stiffness from the optimal TMD sizing (E4). I found 4373 Newtons peak per 400 kilogram unit and about 7 megapascals per bolt in Metric 16 millimetre bolt (M16) groups, according to Den Hartog, 1934 and Eurocode 3, 2005. I propose retaining four preloaded Metric 16 millimetre bolt (M16) per module on galvanized cross-frames with lockable hatches accessed from below. My position: not ready because Structural Dynamics Lead girder fatigue review is still pending. In the deck-view preservation detail, the deck surface and parapet line has risk of visual change from fixings, Structural Dynamics Lead. To check it I used visibility review reusing the concealed mounting cross-section (E7) with clearance from the controlled-response stroke estimate (E6). I found zero change above deck with all hardware below soffit and 12 millimetres stroke within 30 millimetres clearance, according to French Assessment Service for Roads and Motorways (Setra), 2006. I propose soffit-matched finish with no penetration of wearing surface. My position: not ready because joint proposal awaits comfort and fatigue closure.
